5dfe01dc187dd66f.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Commercial Director - Commercial and Reporting to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves leading the commercial and reporting functions for groundbreaking projects, with a focus on optimizing operational effectiveness and aligning with business objectives. The role requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. Role Purpose The Commercial Director will be instrumental in driving the financial performance and strategic direction of Qiddiya's initiatives. This involves providing critical insights through comprehensive commercial strategies and detailed financial reporting to support key decision-making processes. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement comprehensive commercial strategies to drive revenue growth and maximize project profitability. Oversee the preparation of detailed financial reports, forecasting, and performance analysis to support decision-making. Collaborate with finance and project management teams to ensure accurate budgeting, cost control, and financial management. Establish and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor project and operational performance effectively. Ensure compliance with financial regulations and company policies across all commercial activities. Conduct market analysis to identify opportunities for revenue generation and cost savings. Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders and partners to enhance collaboration and support business interests. Lead and mentor the commercial reporting team, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. At least 15 years of experience in commercial management and financial reporting within the Construction or Development sectors. 5d8cfdc052a7943a.description: About the Role ASAS for Developing & Operating Industrial Cities is seeking a Sector General Supervisor to oversee and enhance security and supervisory operations within the sector. This full-time role is based in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah and Makkah, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will ensure project execution aligns with timelines and quality standards, serving as a key reference for evaluation and oversight. Key Responsibilities Field Supervision and Auditing: Conduct regular and unannounced inspection tours to ensure compliance of shift supervisors and security personnel with instructions. Verify that all field activities adhere to industrial city policies and general safety standards. Industrial Control Management (Violations): Prepare accurate reports on "setback storage" violations and ensure emergency and setback passages are clear of obstacles. Monitor and document any operational, environmental, or security violations from factories and establishments within the sector. Leadership Coordination and Performance Meetings: Organize and chair regular meetings with shift supervisors and specialized supervisors to review performance indicators and resolve field challenges. Intervene directly to resolve complex issues that lower supervisory levels cannot address. Complaint and Response Management: Follow up on complaints from investors, factories, or city residents, ensuring immediate and professional resolution and closure of reports. Performance Evaluation and Development: Prepare formal quarterly performance evaluation reports for supervisors (shift and general supervisors) based on efficiency and field results. Identify performance gaps and propose development programs to enhance team efficiency. Strategic Reports (Project Status): Formulate periodic reports for senior management detailing "project health," including: Progress: Achievements against operational plans. Challenges: Obstacles hindering workflow. Risks: Potential threats (security, operational, or structural) and mitigation plans. Required Skills and Competencies Strategic Leadership: Ability to manage multiple teams and motivate them towards overarching goals. Analytical Capability: High proficiency in analyzing field reports and extracting risk indicators. Decisiveness and Objectivity: Ability to fairly evaluate performance and make firm decisions regarding violations. Administrative Communication: High proficiency in drafting correspondence and reports for senior management and external parties. Experience and Work Type Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. This is a full-time position.

Manage the integrated transformation roadmap, translating strategic priorities into sequenced plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes. Establish and manage the squad operating model, including team mandates, ways of working, governance, and accountability. Lead a focused SWAT Squad to deliver high-priority initiatives and resolve critical cross-functional blockers. Define milestone service-level agreements, ownership, dependencies, delivery criteria, and escalation paths. Coordinate stakeholders across business, product, design, engineering, QA, data, AI, architecture, cybersecurity, and operations. Track program progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery confidence, providing clear executive reporting. Strong background in product strategy, roadmap development, program governance, and prioritization. Experience delivering customer-facing digital platforms across web and mobile. 5d1fa82182d6c94e.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Construction Representative on behalf of a leading petrochemical client. This contract position is based in Al Jubayl, Saudi Arabia, and will support major petrochemical projects and construction activities. The role focuses on ensuring construction phases meet project objectives, quality standards, and safety requirements. Role Overview The Construction Representative will be responsible for supporting the planning, execution, monitoring, and completion of construction activities. This includes ensuring compliance with EHS requirements, quality standards, project specifications, schedules, and cost objectives. The successful candidate will coordinate with various functions to achieve project goals and maintain a strong focus on safety and quality throughout the construction lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Ensure construction phases meet EHS, quality, schedule, productivity, and cost objectives. Support the planning, execution, supervision, handover, and completion of construction activities in accordance with contracts, specifications, and standards. Coordinate with project, operations, and maintenance functions to achieve project goals. Ensure implementation of construction safety plans, specifications, procedures, regulatory requirements, and permits in line with Sadara EHS requirements. Promote a zero-incident culture through safety campaigns, site walks, and related activities. Participate in constructability studies, 3D model reviews, risk reviews, progress meetings, root-cause investigations, schedule reviews, audits, and lessons-learned meetings. Support the initiation of contractor claims and change-order requests when defects, contractual inconsistencies, or scope changes are identified. Ensure implementation of quality control plans and involve Asset Integrity experts as required. Monitor and control construction, including changes, additions, work acceptance, and invoice release. Review job specifications to determine suitable construction methods. Ensure red-lined technical documents are available and reflect the current as-built site condition. Participate in project closeout and provide feedback to design teams and contractors. Participate in contractor qualification and selection, construction strategy development, and handover to commissioning. Qualifications and Experience Two-year associate degree in a relevant field. Minimum of 7 years of experience across phases of chemical or petrochemical projects. At least 5 years of experience in quality checks and field quality assurance activities during construction. Relevant experience in project construction within the petroleum or petrochemical industry. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and SAP. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this Construction Representative position.

5d40349fcba0069b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة النجلين لتأجير السيارات عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الترحيب بالزوار والعملاء، وتحديد احتياجاتهم، وتوجيههم إلى الأقسام المختصة. كما يشمل الدور إدارة المكالمات الهاتفية، وتقديم خدمات تأجير السيارات، ومتابعة العقود والحجوزات، وتحصيل المستحقات المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء، والترحيب بهم، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتزويدهم بالمعلومات اللازمة، وتوجيههم إلى المرجع المعني. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى القسم المختص. ترتيب مواعيد المقابلات وتسجيل بيانات المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة. تقديم خدمات تأجير السيارات باحترافية، وتوضيح الشروط والأحكام والأسعار والباقات المتاحة للعملاء. إتمام إجراءات تأجير السيارات وإعداد العقود عبر النظام المعتمد. التحقق من هوية العميل ورخصة القيادة وصلاحيتها، والتأكد من استيفاء جميع شروط التأجير قبل تسليم المركبة. تسليم المركبات للعملاء بعد التأكد من جاهزيتها وتوثيق حالتها، واستلامها عند الإرجاع وتوثيق حالتها. متابعة مواعيد انتهاء العقود والتواصل مع العملاء بشأن التجديد أو إعادة المركبة. تحصيل المبالغ المستحقة وإصدار سندات القبض، ومتابعة المتأخرات المالية والتواصل مع العملاء بشأنها. استقبال شكاوى العملاء وملاحظاتهم والعمل على معالجتها أو إحالتها للمسؤول. التنسيق مع قسم الصيانة بشأن الأعطال والمركبات غير الجاهزة للتأجير. إعداد التقارير اليومية المتعلقة بالتأجير والاستلام والتسليم. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب مكتب الاستقبال. الالتزام بسياسات الشركة وإجراءات العمل والأدلة الإجرائية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية عالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على استخدام أنظمة إعداد العقود وتسجيل البيانات. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية للشركة. القدرة على حل المشكلات وتقديم الدعم للعملاء. المحافظة على سرية بيانات العملاء والمعلومات المتعلقة بالعقود. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ويتطلب التزاماً بالعمل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تركز على خدمة العملاء والالتزام بالإجراءات التشغيلية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

5d187235c33270b5.description: About KONE KONE is recognized as a Top Employer, committed to fostering a positive work environment through effective people practices. This full-time role involves leading and developing strategic customer relationships, identifying value-adding solutions, and contributing to offering and sales development strategies. The position requires 7-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Proactively develop and manage customer relationships within the assigned area. Accountable for enhancing KONE's market position within the customer base or market area. Generate and communicate leads and sales opportunities across the KONE sales team, including cross-selling. Ensure customer satisfaction and resolve complaints in collaboration with the KONE team. Document and maintain accurate customer and contact information. 5dd977bf9f6e5eaa.description: About Unilam Wood Industries KSA Unilam Wood Industries KSA aims to provide innovative wood panel solutions that are contemporary and tailored to customer needs. The company's vision is to be a primary supplier for quality MDF in the MENA region, offering diverse options in wood paneling. The Role of Human Resources Lead Unilam Wood Industries KSA is seeking a Human Resources Lead to manage the full HR function at its Riyadh, KSA location. This full-time role involves independent ownership of people operations, Saudi labor law compliance, payroll, and government platform management. The HR Lead will report directly to the General Manager and is expected to be highly organized, compliance-minded, discreet, and capable of making independent decisions. Key Responsibilities Manage the complete employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, contracts, transfers, renewals, and offboarding processes. Ensure adherence to Saudi Labor Law and maintain alignment of company policies and employment contracts with current regulations. Administer government platforms and filings such as Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, Absher, and Nitaqat, ensuring the company's Saudization status is maintained. Prepare and process monthly payroll, including allowances, deductions, overtime, end-of-service benefits, and WPS requirements. Handle iqama, visa, work permit, and Ajeer contract processing and renewals to prevent lapses in legal status. Coordinate medical insurance for employees and dependents, covering enrollment, eligibility verification, and claims follow-up. Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, and HR documentation in both physical and digital systems. Lead workforce planning, headcount tracking, and manpower requests in coordination with department heads. Manage attendance, leave, and absence records, and address employee relations, disciplinary procedures, and grievances. Prepare HR reports, compliance updates, and analytical insights for the General Manager to support decision-making. Oversee administrative functions related to HR, including company documentation and cross-departmental coordination. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in Human Resources. Demonstrated understanding and application of Saudi Labor Law. Proficiency in managing government platforms relevant to HR operations in Saudi Arabia. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and make informed decisions. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires a presence at the company's Riyadh location to manage all HR functions directly.

5d0e9b73cbf8fc63.description: About the Role emagine is seeking a Senior SAP Technical Consultant to join its team in Dhahran, Eastern region. This full-time role involves leading complex technical implementations, migrations, and optimizations within the SAP S/4HANA ecosystem. The position requires a strategic thinker capable of integrating traditional SAP technical architecture with modern AI-driven capabilities to deliver scalable, secure, and intelligent enterprise solutions. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end technical design, development, and deployment of SAP S/4HANA solutions across on-premise, private cloud, or public cloud environments. Architect and optimize complex integrations using SAP Integration Suite, CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), and OData services. Perform technical assessments, gap analysis, and develop migration strategies for S/4HANA conversions (Brownfield/Greenfield). Develop custom ABAP objects, including ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), AMDP, and Core Data Services (CDS) views. AI and Intelligent Enterprise Integration Identify opportunities to integrate SAP AI Core, SAP AI Business Services, and SAP Joule into existing S/4HANA landscapes. Collaborate with data scientists and AI teams to embed predictive analytics, natural language processing (NLP), and computer vision capabilities into SAP workflows. Design and implement AI-driven automation for processes such as intelligent invoice processing, demand forecasting, and predictive maintenance. Ensure data quality and governance standards are met to support AI/ML model training and inference within the SAP ecosystem. Technical Optimization and Performance Conduct performance tuning and HANA database optimization to ensure high availability and low latency. Implement security best practices, including role-based access control (RBAC) and data encryption. Mentor junior technical consultants and provide thought leadership on SAP technology trends. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in SAP S/4HANA. Deep technical mastery of the SAP ecosystem. Strong understanding of how Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) can be integrated into SAP solutions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dhahran, Eastern region. The role involves working within a team focused on advanced SAP technical implementations and integrations.

5d49a61fda303104.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التاج المضيئ للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال المعدات الكهربائية وصيانتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ. إعداد مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركة المصنعة والتعليمات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الدراسات والتحاليل، وعرضها ومناقشتها. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة جامعية في الهندسة الكهربائية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في التحليل وحل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات التواصل الفعال والعمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة التاج المضيئ للمقاولات، مع التركيز على تنفيذ المشاريع الكهربائية بكفاءة وفعالية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض. سيتم التعامل مع جميع الطلبات بسرية تامة.

Proactive management of customer risks and escalations is also a key aspect of this position. Key Responsibilities Own and manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts. Conduct executive business reviews and governance meetings. Ensure customer objectives align with company capabilities and roadmap. Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and internal processes. Maintain a strong understanding of regulated sectors and industry trends in Saudi Arabia. Employees receive 30 holiday days after their first anniversary, their birthday off, and the option to work remotely for up to 5 weeks per year. Paid leave for new parents is also provided.

Located on the Red Sea coast in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, the resort features 150 keys, five Food & Beverage venues, and a spa. The property aims to provide a blend of guest experiences, from dining to relaxation. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and is open to Saudi Nationals. You will work closely with the Duty Manager to oversee front desk operations and ensure service standards are met. Key Responsibilities Supervise daily Front Office operations, including guest arrivals, departures, room assignments, and cashiering. Lead and support Front Office colleagues to ensure consistent service standards and smooth daily operations. Welcome VIPs and returning guests, ensuring personalized experiences. Handle guest requests, concerns, and complaints professionally, ensuring timely resolution and follow-up. Conduct daily briefings and maintain effective communication across shifts and departments. والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني للعملاء ومعالجة المشكلات المتعلقة بالتطبيقات والأنظمة البرمجية. استقبال بلاغات الأعطال وتحليلها وتصنيفها ومتابعتها حتى إغلاقها. تشخيص المشكلات التقنية من خلال تحليل سجلات الأنظمة (Logs). تثبيت البرامج والأنظمة وإعدادها وتحديثها على الخوادم. مراقبة أداء التطبيقات والخوادم والخدمات لضمان استقرار التشغيل. التعامل مع قواعد بيانات SQL Server وتنفيذ الاستعلامات اللازمة لتحليل المشكلات. فحص واختبار واجهات الربط البرمجية (APIs) باستخدام الأدوات المناسبة. متابعة التكاملات التقنية وتدفق البيانات بين الأنظمة والخدمات المرتبطة بها. مراقبة العمليات المجدولة (Batch Processes) ومعالجة الأخطاء التشغيلية. متابعة خدمات البريد الإلكتروني (SMTP) والرسائل النصية (SMS) المرتبطة بالأنظمة. تحليل متطلبات العملاء وتنفيذ إعدادات الأنظمة وفق احتياجاتهم. التنسيق مع فرق التطوير لمعالجة الأعطال والمشكلات التي تتطلب تدخلاً برمجيًا. تصعيد الأعطال إلى الجهات الخارجية عند الحاجة ومتابعة معالجتها. توثيق المشكلات والحلول وإعداد التقارير الفنية والدورية. تقديم الإرشادات الفنية للعملاء لضمان الاستخدام الصحيح للأنظمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال دعم البرامج أو مجال تقني ذي صلة. القدرة على تشخيص المشكلات التقنية وتحليلها بفعالية. معرفة جيدة بقواعد بيانات SQL Server والقدرة على تنفيذ الاستعلامات. فهم لآليات عمل واجهات الربط البرمجية (APIs). المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الدعم الفني للعملاء. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الأقسام الأخرى. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات. القدرة على توثيق المشكلات والحلول بشكل واضح. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل فني دعم البرامج ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة الأنظمة التقنية للشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة المعالم الدولية للتقنية.

5d2290e2136c5ef0.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Intelligence platform enabling enterprises to understand, engage, and retain customers at scale. Unlike tools that just surface insights, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary AI capabilities, helping teams take action and improve customer experiences across marketing, support, and research. As we scale globally, building reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure is a top priority. DevOps is a core pillar of our engineering strategy, and we are investing heavily in deployment pipelines, observability, and operational efficiency across all products. Why This Role Matters Our engineering teams deliver fast-moving, AI-driven products, and the backbone of their speed and reliability is solid infrastructure and automation. As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll ensure our systems scale seamlessly, deployments happen without friction, and incidents are caught before they impact users. You’ll enable our teams to move faster, focus on building features, and trust that the platform is rock-solid. You’ll be part of shaping the operational culture at Lucidya, where automation, reliability, and proactive problem solving aren’t just buzzwords, they’re outcomes we obsess over every day. What You’ll Do Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and efficient software delivery. Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes. Support cloud infrastructure management and automation using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools such as Grafana. Automate repetitive operational tasks and support development teams with infrastructure and deployment needs. Troubleshoot deployment, application, and infrastructure issues, identifying root causes and implementing solutions. Collaborate with engineers to improve system performance, reliability, and release processes. Follow security best practices across deployment pipelines, applications, and infrastructure. Participate in incident investigation and resolution, escalating complex issues when necessary. Contribute to documentation and continuous improvement of infrastructure workflows and operational processes. Day-to-Day You’ll: Deploy applications and support routine operations within Kubernetes environments. Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines for new and existing services. Monitor system health, investigate alerts, and resolve common deployment and infrastructure issues. Support developers with application deployments, environment configurations, and infrastructure requests. Write and maintain scripts to automate repetitive operational tasks. Assist with infrastructure provisioning and configuration management. Collaborate with senior engineers to investigate complex incidents and improve system reliability. Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation, observability, and operational efficiency. Success Looks Like: Reliable CI/CD pipelines with fewer deployment failures and smoother releases. Successful deployment and operation of containerized applications in Kubernetes. Faster identification and resolution of common infrastructure and deployment issues. Reduced manual operational effort through automation. Improved monitoring, logging, and visibility into application health. Effective collaboration with engineering teams and clear documentation of operational processes. First 90 Days 0–30 Days: Understand Lucidya’s infrastructure, architecture, deployment workflows, tools, and operational practices. Become familiar with existing cloud environments and Kubernetes deployments. 30–60 Days: Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, support routine deployments, troubleshoot common issues, and take ownership of smaller infrastructure tasks with guidance from senior engineers. 60–90 Days: Successfully onboard 2–3 services onto the existing Kubernetes environment, with appropriate CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and health checks, collaborating with senior engineers where needed. Who You Are Experienced: You have 5–7 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or a related role. Hands-On: You have practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. Proactive Problem Solver: You can investigate common technical issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions while knowing when to escalate complex problems. Collaborative: You work closely with developers and other engineers to support deployments and improve infrastructure reliability. Curious & Growth-Oriented: You are eager to learn, improve existing systems, and develop your expertise in cloud infrastructure, automation, and observability. Quality-Focused: You understand the importance of reliable deployments, infrastructure security, monitoring, and operational documentation. Technical Skills You’ll Bring CI/CD: Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or improving CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar. Containers & Orchestration: Practical experience with Docker and working knowledge of Kubernetes, including application deployments, configurations, and troubleshooting. Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools for provisioning and managing infrastructure. Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider, such as AWS or GCP. Scripting & Automation: Ability to write basic automation scripts using Bash or Python. Monitoring & Observability: Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or similar. Configuration Management: Basic knowledge of tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef. Linux & Networking: Working knowledge of Linux systems, networking fundamentals, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and troubleshooting connectivity issues. Version Control: Experience using Git and working with collaborative software development workflows. Experience working in a SaaS, product-based, or AI-driven environment. Exposure to production Kubernetes environments and container orchestration. Familiarity with advanced monitoring, observability, and incident management practices. Understanding of cloud security, secrets management, and infrastructure access controls. Experience optimizing deployment workflows and improving infrastructure reliability. Python knowledge is a must, Software background is mandatory Nice-to-Haves Experience optimizing AI deployment workflows & MlOps practices. Experience optimizing GPU usage for AI workload.

5d1347e8dd668d1c.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Poclain Operator to manage scrap handling operations in Jeddah. This full-time role involves operating an excavator for scrap segregation and truck loading, with a strong emphasis on safety and operational care. The ideal candidate will have 0-1 years of experience in a similar capacity. Key Responsibilities Operate the excavator with precision and adherence to safe operation procedures. Handle scrap materials within the yard for segregation and loading onto trucks. Conduct pre-operation physical inspections of the excavator, including checking engine oil, hydraulic oil, and engine coolant. Inspect the arm and grapier movement before picking up scrap. 5d058815e57967ea.description: Lead and manage protection relay testing and commissioning activities for utility-scale solar PV plants, substations, switchyards, and grid interconnection facilities. Excellent written communication and ad-copywriting skills, with an understanding of how messaging influences engagement and conversions. Familiarity with landing page optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, prioritize competing tasks, and meet deadlines. Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and present insights to stakeholders. Curiosity and adaptability, with a commitment to continuous learning and staying current with digital advertising developments. Experience with tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, WordStream, Optimizely, or Unbounce. Exposure to automated bidding strategies, advertising scripts, or API-based campaign management. Inclusive work environment: Join a supportive workplace that values diverse perspectives and collaboration. Career growth opportunities: Develop your expertise and progress professionally within digital marketing. Professional development: Expand your knowledge of advertising platforms, analytics, and performance optimization.
